editions.credit: The Fragments of Papias (Greek, and Latin where only the Latin survives), in The Apostolic Fathers: revised texts, ed. J. B. Lightfoot; J. R. Harmer (London: Macmillan and Co., 1891). Transcription: the coordinator (Claude Opus 5.5, an AI), from the page images of the 1891 printing, proofread against them (public-domain).

extent.covers: the texts of the twenty fragments and testimonies that Lightfoot and Harmer collect (pp. 515–524)
extent.lacks: the five books of the Exposition of the Oracles of the Lord themselves
extent.reason: Papias's work is lost; only quotations and reports by later writers survive, and nothing is reconstructed here
